## How I checked it

- [ ] the checks that match my change pass (`npm test`, the bootstrap tests, `scripts/check-seed.sh`, an end-to-end script)
- [ ] a test covers the change (and, for an action, who may and who may not do it)
- [ ] docs updated where the behaviour changed
- [ ] no real names, addresses, keys or tokens in tests, docs or examples
